about: Source figures for docs/TTK.md and --ttk-check (tools/ttk_table.py). hp = Base HP at level 1 (supervive_physics.md, ext/agent-briefs briefs/supervive-data) [D]. lmb: dmg per press or round (supervive_kits.md) [D]; at15 = the kit text gives it at level 15, so it is scaled by avg HP L1/L15 (1285.4/2361.7, as DAMAGE_RATIOS.md does); every = seconds between hits, tagged D (data), F (footage, docs/WEAPON_FIRING_DATA.md) or card (KIT_PARITY source card); dps = a per-second figure the kit text gives directly. mode = the LMB mode that figure describes (the check measures that one; without it, the fastest). null = the source gives no number.

gunslinger.why: Cadence: ours 0.12 s a round against ~0.08 s [F, not D], and our sustain rule halves damage after round 10 (the wiki's fall-to-50% reading) with a 1 s refill gap after 30 rounds. Damage per hit is at parity for the first 10 rounds (51 = 3.97% of average HP, ours 6 = 3.9%). Not fixed: the cadence is not [D] and KIT_PARITY row LMB (Vex) calls it a match.
gunslinger.name: Vex

bulwark.why: Within 15% on damage and cadence; the flags are the defender HP share (light Hunters x0.80 die sooner than the source's flat 1290). Different weapon: our tap is a shield throw/bash, the source's an Oath hammer throw (owner call, KIT_PARITY).
bulwark.name: Mossy

mage.why: Cadence: ours 0.648 s against the source's 0.8 s [F, not D] and damage per hit x1.10. The owner kept 0.648 (KIT_PARITY Ryzz LMB, items 70 and 116). Light defenders (x0.80) add to the flags.
mage.name: Ryzz

juggernaut.why: Measured with the press combo (the source's 43-damage figure) at 2.7 m: it cannot reach 8 m, the 8 m LMB is the hold fireblast. Cadence 0.34 s against ~0.2 s [F]; damage per hit 11 against 43 [D], x1.63 after the HP scale. The two roughly cancel (DPS share x0.87), so halving the damage to match the [D] number would make Kael slower, not closer. Not changed.
juggernaut.name: Kael
juggernaut.note: Caldera press 43, swings ~0.2 s apart; hold = fireblast 107

dredge.name: Grimble
dredge.note: shotgun, no damage number (only a % ladder by slugs landed)

ashwick.why: Our figure includes the Flashover rules (+25% on a burning foe, 1.5% max HP a second, 2% a second burn); the source's 258/s is the base stream, its Ignite bonus (a % of max HP) has no number in the data. The bare stream is 27/s = x0.87 of the source. Not fixed: no [D] number to match the bonus.
ashwick.name: Cinder

dolm.name: Tarek
dolm.note: kit text has no damage numbers
